title: Removing a member is confirmed by 'Click again' in the same spot, so a double-click removes them
what_happens: The '…' menu shows 'Remove from list'. One click turns it into 'Click again to remove' in the same place; the second click removes. Delete list and Archive session ask in a dialog instead. Seen: the menu (screenshot). From code, not clicked: I did not press it on production.
who_hurts: An admin who double-clicks the menu item (common habit) removes a person from the list with no real chance to stop.
suggested_fix: Open a small confirm dialog from the menu item ('Remove <name> from <list>?' Cancel / Remove), the same as Delete list in edit-list-form.tsx.
rule: Dane's UI rule: destructive actions 'always ask for confirmation before they run'. Established pattern: Delete list / Archive session confirm in a dialog.
owners_call: Is the 'click again' step enough confirm for removing one number (it's easy to add back)?
